checklist_item.title: Verify Bit-Reversal Consistency: Is BRP applied consistently across all code paths?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify BRP in polynomial_eval_to_coeff (SG-007). 2. Verify BRP in coset_shift_for_cell (SG-016). 3. Verify BRP in coset_for_cell (SG-017). 4. Verify BRP in recover_polynomialcoeff (SG-023). 5. Cross-reference all paths for consistency.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-63, Trust Boundaries: tb-003, tb-009. Inconsistent BRP causes intermittent proof failures.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is batch verification resource cost bounded?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Measure resource cost linear with num_cells. 2. Submit very large verification batches. 3. Verify maximum batch size is bounded. 4. Identify clients lacking batch size limits.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-64, Trust Boundary: tb-007, Threat: stride-dos-tb-007. Unbounded batches exhaust CPU.

checklist_item.title: Verify Fiat-Shamir Hash Security: Is hash_to_bls_field collision-resistant?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify hash function is cryptographically secure. 2. Verify random oracle behavior. 3. Attempt to find two input sets producing same challenge r. 4. Verify hash function is not weak or deprecated.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-65, Trust Boundary: tb-006, Threat: stride-spoofing-tb-006. Hash collision enables proof substitution.

checklist_item.title: Verify Pairing Check Soundness: Does e(LL, LR) == e(RL, [1]) reject invalid proofs?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify pairing check implementation correctness. 2. Submit invalid KZG proofs and verify rejection. 3. Calculate rejection probability (1 - 1/q). 4. Test pairing library for implementation bugs.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-68, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Unsound pairing allows forged proofs.

checklist_item.title: Verify Cryptographic Assumptions: Is BLS12-381 bilinear Diffie-Hellman assumption maintained?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Review cryptographic assumption documentation. 2. Verify BLS12-381 is standard and well-analyzed. 3. Monitor for any mathematical breakthroughs in DLP. 4. Verify implementation uses correct curve parameters.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-69. CONDITIONAL: Foundational assumption. A practical DLP break would be a major mathematical breakthrough.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is total_node_balance computation safe from overflow?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify balance sum is non-negative. 2. Calculate maximum possible sum (validators * max_balance). 3. Verify sum fits in implementation integer type. 4. Test with large validator sets for overflow.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-70, Trust Boundary: tb-011. Overflow produces incorrect custody requirements.

checklist_item.title: Verify Fork Epoch Ordering: Are fork epoch constants strictly ordered?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify GENESIS_FORK_EPOCH < ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH < ... < FULU_FORK_EPOCH. 2. Compare fork epoch values across client implementations. 3. Verify compute_fork_version returns correct version for each epoch. 4. Identify any client with mis-ordered constants.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W4B13-1, Trust Boundaries: tb-009, tb-010. Mis-ordering causes network-wide consensus split.

checklist_item.title: Verify Fork Version Function: Does compute_fork_version return exactly one version for any epoch?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify if-else cascade is mutually exclusive and exhaustive. 2. Test every epoch boundary value. 3. Verify exactly one branch is taken for each epoch. 4. Identify any epoch where function fails or returns wrong version.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W4B13-2, Trust Boundary: tb-009. Missing branch causes crash or wrong domain separation.

checklist_item.title: Verify Fork Version Robustness: Does compute_fork_version handle edge-case epochs?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Test with epoch = 0. 2. Test with epoch = uint64_max. 3. Verify function never returns null, panics, or throws. 4. Craft ENR records with extreme epoch values and test.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W4B13-3, Trust Boundary: tb-009. Edge case epochs in ENR records cause DoS.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does extract_deposit_data strictly validate that the pubkey offset equals PUBKEY_OFFSET before processing deposit data?
checklist_item.test_procedure:
1. Locate the extract_deposit_data function and identify the pubkey offset validation logic.
2. Verify that Uint.from_be_bytes(data[0:32]) is compared against PUBKEY_OFFSET constant.
3. Craft deposit data with an invalid pubkey offset (e.g., off by one byte) and submit via transaction.
4. Verify the function raises InvalidBlock exception when offset validation fails.
5. Test boundary conditions: offset = PUBKEY_OFFSET - 1, PUBKEY_OFFSET + 1, 0, MAX_UINT.
6. Confirm no code path bypasses the offset validation check.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W6B15-11, Trust Boundary: tb-002, Invariant: SG-001/INV-002, Threat: stride-004
